theorem_title: Actual-orbit affine envelope and first crossing time
natural_language_statement: For every finite actual shortcut prefix, 2^k*T^k(n)=3^(q_k)*n+C_k. Under every prior coefficient barrier 2^j<=3^(q_j) for j<k, C_k<=Cmax(q_k). At a first coefficient contraction, k=floor(log2(3^(q_k)))+1. For positive n and a nonnegative first-contraction defect d, the older inequality 3*d<q_k also follows. Limitations: First-contraction existence is assumed for the crossing and defect claims. Full extremizer uniqueness and displacement-penalty formulations in the prose L9 note are outside these formal statements.
